enabled.description: Whether the GNSS sharing daemon should be started automatically.

api.bind_address.description: IP address on which the local HTTP status/metadata API will listen.

api.port.description: Port for the local HTTP API (status, metrics, control).

gnss.device_path.description: Device file path to the GNSS receiver (e.g., GPS USB device or serial port).

gnss.baud_rate.description: Serial baud rate for communication with the GNSS device.

gnss.accepted_nmea_types.description: List of NMEA sentence types to parse and share. Common types: GGA (position fix), RMC (recommended minimum), VTG (velocity).

gnss.min_satellites.description: Minimum satellites required for a valid fix. Prevents sharing low-accuracy locations.

gnss.max_position_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for a position data point before it's considered stale and discarded.

logging.position_log_path.description: Absolute path to the log file where successfully parsed positions are stored.

logging.log_level.description: Verbosity of daemon logging. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the sharing peer.

port.description: Port on the peer to connect to.

sharing.peers.description: List of remote services to share GNSS position updates with.

sharing.tls.enabled.description: Whether to use TLS (HTTPS) when sharing data with peers.

sharing.tls.cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate used for peer authentication and encryption.

sharing.tls.key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key used for TLS connections.

sharing.cache_path.description: Path to the JSON file used to cache recent shared positions for retransmission or recovery.

sharing.interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between position-sharing attempts to peers (minimum recommended: 5).
